Ship to the United Kingdom from Indonesia

Door-to-door international express from anywhere in Indonesia to the United Kingdom: documents, samples and parcels.

Two services to the United Kingdom

  • PCW Priority Express: our fastest service for documents, samples and urgent goods; pickup anywhere in Indonesia.
  • PCW Economy Express: lower-cost, all-in price for non-urgent parcels.

Before you send

Destination duties and taxes are paid by the receiver unless agreed otherwise. Situational surcharges (for example remote areas or special goods) are told to you before you agree.

How it works

Check the rate

Enter the weight and size of your package to see the published price to the United Kingdom.

Book online

Fill in the sender, receiver and contents. You get a PCW reference number at once.

Pickup or drop-off

Priority pickup is available anywhere in Indonesia. Economy pickup is online inside Jakarta; other cities by request.

We confirm and ship

Our team confirms the final weight and price, then your shipment leaves with an air waybill and tracking.

FAQ

How much does it cost to ship to the United Kingdom?

Check the rates page: enter the weight and size and you see the published price for PCW Priority Express and PCW Economy Express to the United Kingdom. Regular shippers get their own business rates.

Who pays duties and taxes in the United Kingdom?

The receiver, unless we agree otherwise in writing.

How is the chargeable weight calculated?

It is the higher of the actual weight and L x W x H (cm) / 5000. Priority is rounded up to the next 0.5 kg, Economy to the next 1 kg.

How long does delivery take?

The transit time is given in your quote. Priority is our fastest service; Economy is the lower-cost option for non-urgent parcels.
